faqs.q: What should I do immediately during an urgent water leak emergency?
faqs.a: First, shut off the main water valve to prevent further structural damage. Then contact our direct line immediately for priority emergency dispatch.

faqs.q: Is a tankless water heater worth the investment?
faqs.a: Tankless systems provide continuous on-demand hot water, take up 80% less space, and last up to 20 years—roughly double the lifespan of traditional tank heaters while reducing energy usage.

faqs.q: Do you charge flat-rate or hourly pricing?
faqs.a: We provide upfront flat-rate quotes after diagnosing the issue. You approve the exact cost before any work begins, so there are no open-ended hourly surprises.

faqs.q: How often should residential sewer and drain pipes be cleaned?
faqs.a: For homes older than 10 years or with mature trees nearby, annual or biennial video pipe inspections and preventative drain cleanings prevent costly backups.
